The Analytics Engine team has launched a complete revamp of the [climakitae documentation](https://cal-adapt.github.io/climakitae/dev/). The updated docs introduce the new ClimateData interface and its associated processors, replacing the legacy DataParameters and `get_data()` workflow. New additions include a Notebook Gallery showcasing cae-notebooks, How-To guides covering common tasks like clipping, exporting, and bias correction, and a Migration Guide to help users transition from the old interface to ClimateData.
